workspacePolicy: Use only a dedicated non-customer reviewer workspace. Never select an arbitrary customer workspace.

positive.prompt: List my authorized CrossCheck workspaces, then in my selected reviewer test workspace create and publish a small Briefing about its latest completed snapshot.
positive.expected: Returns only authorized workspaces, grounds the analysis in retrieved data, and publishes the requested artifact to the selected test workspace with its actual links.

positive.prompt: In my selected reviewer environment, show up to five currencies from live NetSuite.
positive.expected: Returns a bounded SELECT-only result from the selected NetSuite environment, names the role that answered, explains audit and possible caching, and does not modify NetSuite records.

positive.prompt: In my selected reviewer environment, draft a small supported record-read Test Suite, validate it and show what it will check; after I approve that exact suite, register it and tell me where to start one run.
positive.expected: Reads the supported case, assertion and action vocabulary, validates before registration, registers only the approved suite, and returns the CrossCheck suite page with the steps and target environment for a person to start the run; it does not start the run or claim a result.

positive.prompt: In my selected reviewer workspace, use a supported published test case to draft and preview a small Stress Test; after I approve its exact workload, publish it and show its CrossCheck page. If an existing Run is available, read its progress and report; do not start a new Run.
positive.expected: Shows the supported case and exact workload, validates and previews before the approved publication, returns the actual CrossCheck page, and reads an existing Run if available without starting one or inventing results.

positive.prompt: In my selected reviewer Shopify environment, list recent backups, inspect one sealed backup and a Product record with personal data omitted, then show recent restore and sync runs. Explain a possible recovery scope without starting a snapshot, restore, or sync.
positive.expected: Selects an authorized Shopify environment, returns actual sealed-backup and Product details with personal data excluded, reads restore and sync history, and explains any missing data or recovery scope without a write.

negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected: The app should not be invoked because it has no calendar capability.

negative.prompt: Send an email to my project team with today's status.
negative.expected: The app should not be invoked because it cannot send emails or messages.

negative.prompt: Create a new sales order directly in NetSuite.
negative.expected: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide a general NetSuite record-creation tool.
